an3.4:1.1: “Bhikkhus, one who possesses three qualities should be known as a fool.
an3.4:1.3: (1) He does not see his transgression as a transgression. (2) When he sees his transgression as a transgression, he does not make amends for it in accordance with the Dhamma. (3) When another person confesses a transgression to him, he does not accept it in accordance with the Dhamma.
an3.4:1.4: One who possesses these three qualities should be known as a fool.
an3.4:2.1: “One who possesses three qualities should be known as a wise person.
an3.4:2.3: (1) He sees a transgression as a transgression. (2) When he sees a transgression as a transgression, he makes amends for it in accordance with the Dhamma. (3) When another person confesses a transgression to him, he accepts it in accordance with the Dhamma.
an3.4:2.4: One who possesses these three qualities should be known as a wise person.
an3.4:2.5: “Therefore … It is in this way that you should train yourselves.”
